_comment: Client spellings the sheet stores as one glued, shouting string — legal names
pasted out of an invoicing system, e.g. DENTSUADVERTISINGANDMEDIASERVICESINDIA-
PRIVATELIMITED. They are unreadable on screen and worse in a downloaded CSV a
person has to work a call list from.
Only word breaks and capitalisation are set here. The company is never changed,
never shortened to a trading name, and never merged with another spelling — a
name that needs a judgement about identity belongs in the sheet, not in this
file. If the sheet itself is fixed, delete the entry; nothing here depends on it
The key is the sheet's spelling with case, spaces and punctuation removed, so
every way of typing the same name lands on the same entry. ingest also splits a
glued name on its own when every piece is a word it already knows, and lists
the ones it could not resolve, so a new legal name shows up in the report

names.dentsuadvertisingandmediaservicesindiapr: Dentsu Advertising and Media Services India Private Limited
names.collectiveartistsnetworkindiaprivatelimi: Collective Artists Network India Private Limited
